scope: Seven proposed frontend files, orphan Git blobs only. No tree, commit, branch, deployment, APP mutation, real account, source read, schedule or notification.
problem: After a current map read fails, retained same-revision action_now may still be displayed until expiry. The local temporary-memory hook also admitted old responses and exposed another owner's retained data before refresh.

behavior.current_source: A supplied star uses only readError from its supplying map; a locally selected star uses only useTemporaryMemory.error.
behavior.unavailable: Stato non verificabile. Cached context is retained; the old imperative, estimate window and next-check/notification promises are not presented as current. An unavailable first read does not claim there are no Situations.
behavior.recovery: Only the current owner's latest successful read restores presentation. Older requests, previous refresh generations and unmounted/disabled scopes cannot publish or clear a newer error. A current empty map removes the previous star.
behavior.unchanged: Existing polling intervals, foreground triggers, cancellation API/owner checks, outcome expiry/revision checks, and conversation prose remain. No new historical receipt UI.

verification.executed: V8 exact JavaScript function bodies with TypeScript annotations/imports removed; hook scheduling/API are deterministic adapters from the proposed CJS test. Node TypeScript transpilation, React/browser, and component render cases not executed here.
